title: Kickstarter Campaign Tracker Input
description: Pull Kickstarter campaigns by category, search term, state, and sort. Each campaign ships as one row with funding, backers, pledge tiers, and creator data. Optional enrichment pulls full reward tiers and update counts per campaign.

queries.title: Search terms
queries.description: Free text Kickstarter search terms. Example: ["smart home", "board game", "wallet"]. Empty means do not run any keyword search.
queries.sectionDescription: Provide at least one of: queries, categories, or projectUrls.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Kickstarter top level category slugs. Empty means pull across all categories.

projectUrls.title: Project URLs
projectUrls.description: Direct kickstarter.com project URLs to fetch. Example: ["https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/creator/slug"]. Skips discovery and goes straight to detail enrichment.

country.title: Country
country.description: Filter to campaigns based in one country. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for example US, GB, DE, JP. Empty means worldwide.

minPercentFunded.title: Minimum percent funded
minPercentFunded.description: Only push campaigns at or above this funding percent. 100 means fully funded only. 0 disables the filter.

minBackers.title: Minimum backers
minBackers.description: Only push campaigns with at least this many backers. 0 disables the filter.

minPledgedUsd.title: Minimum pledged (USD)
minPledgedUsd.description: Only push campaigns with at least this much pledged in USD. 0 disables the filter.

launchedAfterDays.title: Launched within last N days
launchedAfterDays.description: Only push campaigns launched within this many days. 0 disables the filter.

fetchRewards.title: Fetch reward tiers
fetchRewards.description: Fetch the full pledge reward tiers per campaign. Adds rewards[] with title, price, backer count, items, estimated delivery, and shipping options. Adds one extra request per campaign.
fetchRewards.sectionDescription: Each enrichment toggle adds requests per campaign. Use with maxCampaigns to bound cost.

fetchUpdates.title: Fetch update count
fetchUpdates.description: Fetch the number of creator updates, comments, and FAQ entries per campaign. Adds updateCount, commentCount, faqCount.

fetchCreator.title: Fetch creator history
fetchCreator.description: Fetch the creator profile to count prior launched projects and lifetime backers. Adds creatorLaunchedCount and creatorBackedCount.

maxCampaigns.title: Total maximum campaigns
maxCampaigns.description: Hard cap on campaign rows pushed per run. 0 means unlimited.

maxPagesPerSeed.title: Max pages per seed
maxPagesPerSeed.description: Pages of 12 campaigns to walk per seed. Kickstarter discover caps near 200 pages per filter combination.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip project IDs already pushed in previous runs. Keyed on Kickstarter project ID. Turn off to refresh stale rows.

navigationDelayMs.title: Delay between navigations (ms)
navigationDelayMs.description: Pause between page loads. Kickstarter throttles fast scraping. 1500 to 4000 ms is the safe range.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Parallel HTTP requests. Keep at 2 to 4 unless you have a residential proxy pool.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Datacenter works for low volume. Switch to residential past a few hundred requests in a short window.
